mapper.select: select detail_id, return_id, sales_detail_id, item_type, item_id, item_code, item_name, product_id, product_name, sku, spec, unit, quantity, unit_price, amount, returned_quantity, returned_cost_amount from inv_sales_return_detail where return_id = #{returnId}

select detail_id, return_id, sales_detail_id, item_type, item_id, item_code, item_name, product_id, product_name, sku, spec, unit, quantity, unit_price, amount, returned_quantity, returned_cost_amount from inv_sales_return_detail where return_id = #{returnId} for update

select d.detail_id, d.return_id, d.sales_detail_id, d.item_type, d.item_id, d.product_id, d.quantity, d.returned_quantity, d.returned_cost_amount from inv_sales_return_detail d inner join inv_sales_return r on r.return_id = d.return_id where r.sales_order_id = #{salesOrderId} and (d.sales_detail_id = #{salesDetailId} or (d.sales_detail_id is null and coalesce(nullif(d.item_type, ''), 'product') = #{itemType} and coalesce(d.item_id, d.product_id) = #{itemId})) and (coalesce(d.returned_quantity, 0) > 0 or r.status = 'returned') order by d.detail_id for update
mapper.insert: insert into inv_sales_return_detail ( return_id, sales_detail_id, item_type, item_id, item_code, item_name, product_id, product_name, sku, spec, unit, quantity, unit_price, amount, returned_quantity, returned_cost_amount ) values ( #{returnId}, #{salesDetailId}, #{itemType}, #{itemId}, #{itemCode}, #{itemName}, #{productId}, #{productName}, #{sku}, #{spec}, #{unit}, #{quantity}, #{unitPrice}, #{amount}, 0, 0 )
